l-m-h2-b0d01-01.title: Ese log(a+b)=log a+log b bihora ari ukuri?
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.goal: Suzuma niba igitekerezo log₂(a+b)=log₂a+log₂b gihora ari ukuri, ushake kandi usobanure urugero rutari rwo (urugero ruvuguruza).
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.material: Igitekerezo: ku mibare myiza a na b, log₂(a+b)=log₂a+log₂b bihora ari ukuri. Shaka a na b bigaragaza ko iki gitekerezo kitari cyo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.prompt: Ni iyihe a na b bitanga urugero ruvuguruza igitekerezo?
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.r.a: log₂4=2 kandi 1+1=2; bityo biremewe. Si urugero ruvuguruza.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.r.b: a+b=ab=9/2; bityo agaciro kabyombi karangana. Si urugero ruvuguruza.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.r.c: a+b=ab=16/3; bityo agaciro kabyombi karangana. Si urugero ruvuguruza.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.explain: Niba a=b=4, log₂8=3 ariko log₂4+log₂4=4. Igiteranyo cya logaritimu gihwanye n'igiteranyo cy'imibare iri imbere yayo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s2.model.0: Niba a=b=4, log₂8=3 ariko log₂4+log₂4=4; bityo agaciro karatandukanye kandi ni urugero ruvuguruza.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s2.model.1: log₂a+log₂b=log₂(ab); bityo bingana gusa iyo a+b=ab. Kubera ko 4+4≠16, a=b=4 ni urugero ruvuguruza.

l-m-h2-b0d01-10.title: Shin jadawalin aikin exponent da na logaritm koyaushe suna haɗuwa?
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.goal: Bincika ko ikirarin cewa jadawalin y=aˣ da y=logₐx dole su haɗu gaskiya ne koyaushe, nemo kuma ka bayyana yanayin da ya gaza (misalin karyatawa).
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.material: Ikirari: Idan a>1, jadawalin y=aˣ da y=logₐx dole su haɗu. Nemo a da ke nuna kuskuren ikirarin.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.prompt: Wane a ne misalin karyatawa ga ikirarin?
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.r.a: A x=1, aˣ>x, a x=3 kuma aˣ<x, saboda haka ya haɗu da y=x.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.r.b: A x=1, aˣ>x, a x=2 kuma aˣ<x, saboda haka ya haɗu da y=x.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.r.c: A x=2 da 4, aˣ=x, don haka jadawalin biyun suna haɗuwa.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.explain: Idan a=2, to 2ˣ>x, saboda haka x>log₂x. 2ˣ yana sama da y=x, log₂x kuma ƙasa da shi, don haka ba sa haɗuwa.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s2.model.0: Idan a=2, 2ˣ>x da x>log₂x ne, saboda haka y=2ˣ yana sama da y=x, y=log₂x kuma ƙasa da y=x, ba sa haɗuwa.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s2.model.1: 2ˣ koyaushe yana sama da y=x, aikin juyawarsa log₂x kuma koyaushe ƙasa da y=x; don haka a=2 wanda ba shi da haɗuwar jadawali misalin karyatawa ne.

l-m-h2-b0d01-13.title: Idan θ ya ƙaru, shin sinθ koyaushe yana ƙaruwa?
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.goal: Bincika ko ikirarin cewa sinθ yana ƙaruwa yayin da kusurwar ke ƙaruwa gaskiya ne koyaushe, nemo kuma ka bayyana yanayin da ya gaza (misalin karyatawa).
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.material: Ikirari: Ga 0°≤θ≤180°, duk lokacin da kusurwa θ ta ƙaru, darajar sinθ dole ta ƙaru. Nemo canjin da ke karyata ikirarin.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s1.prompt: Wane canji ne ya saɓa wa ikirarin?
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s1.r.a: sin10°<sin20°, saboda haka darajar ta ƙaru. Ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s1.r.b: Ya ƙaru daga 1/2 zuwa √3/2. Ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s1.r.c: Ya ƙaru daga √2/2 zuwa 1. Ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s1.explain: sin90°=1 kuma sin150°=1/2 ne, don haka θ ya ƙaru amma darajar ta ragu. Bayan 90° tana raguwa.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s2.model.0: θ ya ƙaru daga 90° zuwa 150°, amma sin90°=1, sin150°=1/2 ne, ya ragu, saboda haka misali ne na karyatawa.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s2.model.1: sinθ yana ƙaruwa har zuwa 90°, daga nan kuma yana raguwa; saboda haka canjin 90° zuwa 150° ne ke karya ikirarin.

l-m-h2-b0d01-21.s.s1.explain: Idan A=20° kuma B=70°, to sin40°=sin140°; sharadin ya cika, amma A≠B, saboda haka a≠b (A+B=90°).

l-m-h2-b0d05-03.title: Shin P(A|B) da P(B|A) koyaushe daidai suke?

l-m-h2-b0d05-03.material: Ikirari: Ga abubuwa A da B biyu, yiwuwar sharadi P(A|B) da P(B|A) koyaushe daidai suke. Gwada ikirarin da ma'auratan abubuwa na jefa dan lido.

l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.r.b: Dukkansu suna da sakamako 3, A∩B={1, 3}, saboda haka ƙimomin biyu 2/3 ne.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.o.c: A: 3 ko ƙasa, B: 4 ko fiye
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.r.c: A∩B saiti marar komai ne, saboda haka ƙimomin biyun 0 ne.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.r.d: Abu ɗaya ne, saboda haka ƙimomin biyun 1 ne.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.explain: P(A|B)=n(A∩B)/n(B), P(B|A)=n(A∩B)/n(A). Ga ma'aura da 4 ko ƙasa, sun bambanta: 1/2 da 2/3.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s2.model.0: Idan A=ma'aura, B=4 ko ƙasa, to P(A|B)=2/4=1/2, P(B|A)=2/3, ƙimomin sun bambanta. Wannan misali ne na karyatawa.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s2.model.1: Ma'aunansu sun bambanta, n(B)=4, n(A)=3, don haka ko da A∩B yana da sakamako 2, yiwuwar sharadi biyun sun bambanta.

l-m-h2-b0d06-04.material: Ikirari: Idan aka faɗaɗa (ax+b)ⁿ, coefficient na xʳ koyaushe coefficient ɗin binomial nCr ne. Gwada ta kwatanta coefficient na kalmar da aka bayar da nCr a faɗaɗawa.
l-m-h2-b0d06-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi faɗaɗawar da ta saɓa wa ikirarin.
l-m-h2-b0d06-04.s.s1.r.b: Coefficient ɗin 4C2=6 ne, saboda haka ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-h2-b0d06-04.s.s1.r.c: Coefficient ɗin 6C3=20 ne, saboda haka ya dace da ikirarin.

l-m-h2-b0d06-04.s.s1.explain: Coefficient na kalmar x² ta (2x+1)³ shi ne 3C2×2²=12. Ya bambanta da 3C2=3 saboda coefficient 2 na x ana ninka shi da kansa sau biyu.
l-m-h2-b0d06-04.s.s2.model.0: Kalmar x² ta (2x+1)³ tana da coefficient 3C2×2²=12, amma 3C2=3, ƙimomin sun bambanta. Shi ya sa faɗaɗawar nan misali ce ta karyatawa.
l-m-h2-b0d06-04.s.s2.model.1: Saboda ana ninka coefficient 2 na x sau r (ana ɗaga shi ƙarfin r), coefficient ɗin ya fi nCr girma. Don haka kalmar x² ta (2x+1)³ tana da 12, ta bambanta da 3C2.

l-m-h2-b0d01-22.s.s1.r.a: Ana zaɓar ka'idar bisa ma'auni ɗaya, ko akwai kusurwar dama ko babu.
l-m-h2-b0d01-22.s.s1.o.b: Ko an bayar da girman kusurwa da digiri
l-m-h2-b0d01-22.s.s1.r.b: Ka'idar ɗaya ce, ko ana amfani da digiri ko radian.
l-m-h2-b0d01-22.s.s1.o.c: Ko ƙimomin da aka bayar lambobi cikakku ne
l-m-h2-b0d01-22.s.s1.r.c: Kasancewa lamba cikakkiya ko a'a ba ma'aunin zaɓar ka'ida ba ne.
l-m-h2-b0d01-22.s.s1.o.d: Ko an bayar da haɗin gefe da kusurwar da ke gabansa
l-m-h2-b0d01-22.s.s1.explain: Idan akwai haɗin gefe da kusurwar gabansa, a yi amfani da ka'idar sine; idan kuma an bayar da gefuna biyu da kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu ko gefuna uku, a yi amfani da ka'idar cosine.
l-m-h2-b0d01-22.s.s2.model.0: Idan an bayar da gefe da kusurwar gabansa a matsayin biyu, ana iya amfani da rabon ka'idar sine. Idan babu irin wannan biyu, dole a yi amfani da ka'idar cosine; saboda haka wannan biyu ne ma'aunin.
l-m-h2-b0d01-22.s.s2.model.1: Idan babu gefe da kusurwar gabansa a matsayin biyu, kamar gefuna biyu da kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu ko gefuna uku, ba za a iya kafa rabon ka'idar sine ba; saboda haka ana fara da ka'idar cosine.

l-m-h2-b0d01-25.title: Ma'aunin da ke nuna ko jerin geometric yana ƙaruwa
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.goal: Domin gano ko jerin geometric jerin ƙaruwa ne, ƙayyade wane ma'auni (bayani) ake buƙata da gaske, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.material: Muna son sanin ko jerin geometric aₙ=a·rⁿ⁻¹ (a≠0, r>0) jerin ƙaruwa ne. Wane bayani ake buƙata da gaske?
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ake buƙata da gaske don sanin ko yana ƙaruwa?
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.s.s1.o.a: Ko rabo na gama-gari ya fi 1 girma kawai
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.s.s1.r.a: Idan kalmar farko ba ta da kyau, jerin yana raguwa ko da rabo na gama-gari ya fi 1 girma.
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.s.s1.o.b: Ko kalmar farko lamba cikakkiya ce
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.s.s1.r.b: Kasancewa lamba cikakkiya ba shi da alaƙa da ƙaruwa ko raguwa.
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.s.s1.r.c: Jimlar kaɗai ba ta nuna ko kalmomin suna ƙaruwa ba.
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.s.s1.o.d: Alamar kalmar farko da ko rabo na gama-gari ya fi 1 girma
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.s.s1.explain: Idan a>0, jerin yana ƙaruwa idan r>1; idan a<0, yana ƙaruwa idan 0<r<1. Ana buƙatar sanin alamar a da girman r duka.
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.s.s2.model.0: Idan a>0 kuma r>1, jerin yana ƙaruwa; idan a<0, yana ƙaruwa idan 0<r<1. Saboda haka alamar kalmar farko da ko rabo na gama-gari ya fi 1 girma su ne bayanan da ake buƙata.
l-m-h2-b0d01-25.s.s2.model.1: −3, −6, −12 yana da rabo na gama-gari 2 amma yana raguwa; saboda haka rabon kaɗai bai isa ba. Ana kuma buƙatar sanin alamar kalmar farko.

l-m-h2-b0d02-01.title: Wane sharadi ake buƙata domin logaritm ya kasance a fayyace?
l-m-h2-b0d02-01.goal: Yanke shawarar ma'aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata da gaske domin nemo sharadin log_a b ya kasance a fayyace, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h2-b0d02-01.material: A logaritm log_a b, a shi ne tushe, b kuma abun ciki. Muna son gano sharuɗɗan da ake buƙata tare domin logaritm ɗin ya zama ƙima guda ta ainihi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-01.s.s1.prompt: Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa sharuɗɗan da ake buƙata daidai?
l-m-h2-b0d02-01.s.s1.r.a: Idan tushe mara kyau ne, aˣ ba za a iya ayyana shi ga kowace lambar ainihi x ba.
l-m-h2-b0d02-01.s.s1.r.c: Idan a=1, kowane ƙarfin 1 koyaushe 1 ne, saboda haka log₁5 ba shi da daraja.
l-m-h2-b0d02-01.s.s1.r.d: Yanayi kamar log_(1/2)4=−2, inda a<1 ko b<1, su ma ana iya fayyace su.
l-m-h2-b0d02-01.s.s1.explain: Tushe dole ne ya zama tabbatacce kuma ba 1 ba, abun ciki kuma tabbatacce.
l-m-h2-b0d02-01.s.s2.model.0: Idan tushe 1 ne, 1ˣ koyaushe 1 ne, idan kuma mara kyau ne aˣ ba a fayyace ba; saboda haka a>0 da a≠1 ake buƙata. Tunda aˣ>0, b>0 ma wajibi ne.
l-m-h2-b0d02-01.s.s2.model.1: Tunda aˣ koyaushe tabbatacce ne, abun ciki dole ya cika b>0; idan tushe 1 ne, kowane x yana bayar da 1, saboda haka a≠1 wajibi ne.

l-m-h2-b0d02-15.title: Ƙimar da ke ƙayyade zangon y=a sin(bx+c)+d
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.goal: Yanke shawarar ma'aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata da gaske domin nemo coefficient mai ƙayyade zango, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.material: Muna son nemo zango daga jadawalin nau'in y=a sin(bx+c)+d. Wace ƙima daga a, b, c, d ake buƙata da gaske? (a da b ba 0 ba ne.)
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙima ce ake buƙata da gaske domin sanin zango?
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.r.a: a yana ƙayyade girman faɗaɗa. Ba shi da alaƙa da zango.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.r.b: c yana ƙayyade matsawa hagu-dama kawai. Zango bai canza ba.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.r.c: d yana ƙayyade matsawa sama-ƙasa kawai. Zango bai canza ba.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.explain: Zango 2π/|b| ne. a yana ƙayyade girman faɗaɗa, c matsawar hagu-dama, d kuma sama-ƙasa.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s2.model.0: Zango yana ƙayyadewa da 2π/|b|, saboda haka cikakkiyar darajar b kaɗai ake buƙata. a,c,d suna canza matsayi ko faɗaɗa siffar kawai.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s2.model.1: Miƙa ko matsar da jadawali sama-ƙasa ba ya canza tsawon kwance na maimaitawa, saboda haka b kaɗai, wanda ke matsar da kwance, ke ƙayyade zango.

l-m-h2-b0d02-36.title: Induction ga furucin da ke aiki idan n≥3
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.goal: Gano wane ma'auni (bayani) ake buƙata da gaske domin tabbatar da furucin da ke aiki ga n≥3 ta induction, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.material: Muna son tabbatar da furucin “2ⁿ>2n+1 ga lambobin halitta n≥3” ta induction. Mu gano binciken da ake buƙata da gaske.
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s1.prompt: Wadanne bincike ake buƙata da gaske ga hujjar?
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s1.o.a: Yana aiki ga n=3, kuma daga k zuwa k+1 (k≥3)
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s1.o.b: Nuna cewa ƙarya ne ga n=1 da 2
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s1.r.b: Nuna ƙaryarsa a wajen zangon ba a buƙata ga hujjar.
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s1.o.c: Lissafa ɗaya bayan ɗaya har n=100
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s1.r.c: Lissafi mai iyaka ba zai tabbatar da shi ga n duka ba.
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s1.o.d: Bincika kawai cewa yana aiki ga n=1
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s1.r.d: A n=1, 2>3 ƙarya ne. Wurin farawa n=3 ne.
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s1.explain: Wurin farawa n=3 ne. Duba 8>7 a n=3, sannan nuna cewa ga k≥3 idan yana aiki ga k, yana aiki ga k+1 ma.
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s2.model.0: Zangon furucin n≥3 ne, saboda haka matakin tushe shi ne duba 8>7 a n=3, sannan a nuna matakin induction k→k+1 ga k≥3.
l-m-h2-b0d02-36.s.s2.model.1: Furucin ƙarya ne ga n=1 da 2, saboda haka dole ne a fara daga n=3 sannan a nuna matakin da ke tafiya daga k zuwa k+1.

l-m-h2-b0d03-02.goal: Gano ma'aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata da gaske domin nemo iyakar furucin kaso yayin x→∞, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.material: Yi la'akari da furuci kamar (3x²+5x−2)/(2x²−7), inda mai lissafi da ma'auni polinomi ne. Wane bayani ya kamata a duba domin nemo iyaka yayin x ya ƙaru ba iyaka?
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi bayanin da ake buƙata da gaske domin yanke iyakar.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.r.a: Ma'aunan kalmomin digiri ƙasa ba sa ƙayyade iyaka.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.o.b: Digiri da ma'aunan kalmomi mafi girma na mai lissafi da ma'auni
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.o.c: Darajar da aka samu idan x=0
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.r.c: Wannan matsalar x→∞ ce, don haka darajar x=0 ba ta da muhimmanci.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.r.d: Tasirin ƙimomin dindindin yana raguwa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.explain: Idan x ya yi girma sosai, kalmar digiri mafi girma ce ke rinjayar furucin. Idan digiri iri ɗaya ne, yana kusantar rabon ma'aunan, 3/2.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s2.model.0: Kalmomin digiri mafi girma ne ke rinjayar furucin, kamar mai lissafi 3x² da ma'auni 2x², saboda haka rabon ma'aunan, 3/2, shi ne iyaka.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s2.model.1: Idan x ya yi girma sosai, za a iya watsi da kalmomin digiri ƙasa, saboda haka digiri da ma'aunan kalmomin mafi girma kaɗai ke ƙayyade iyaka.

l-m-h2-b0d03-09.title: Wane bayani ake buƙata domin iyakar |x|/x a x=0?
l-m-h2-b0d03-09.goal: Gano ma'aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata da gaske domin sanin ko |x|/x yana da iyaka a x=0, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h2-b0d03-09.material: Akwai f(x)=|x|/x (x≠0). Muna son sanin ko f(x) yana da iyaka yayin x ke kusantar 0.
l-m-h2-b0d03-09.s.s1.o.a: Darajojin yayin x ke kusantar 0 daga dama da hagu
l-m-h2-b0d03-09.s.s1.r.b: Iyakar ba ta da alaƙa da darajar a x=0 kanta.
l-m-h2-b0d03-09.s.s1.r.c: Mafi girman ƙima kaɗai ba ya nuna ƙimar da y ke kusantowa idan x yana kusa da 0.
l-m-h2-b0d03-09.s.s1.r.d: Ƙimar wani wuri mai nisa ba ta da alaƙa da iyaka.
l-m-h2-b0d03-09.s.s1.explain: Ƙimarsa 1 ce idan x>0, kuma −1 idan x<0. Iyakacin dama 1 da iyakacin hagu −1 sun bambanta; saboda haka iyakar ba ta wanzu.
l-m-h2-b0d03-09.s.s2.model.0: Iyaka tana wanzuwa ne kawai idan ƙimomin da ake kusantowa daga ɓangarorin biyu yayin da x ke kusantar 0 sun yi daidai; saboda haka dole a duba hagu da dama dabam.
l-m-h2-b0d03-09.s.s2.model.1: f(0) ba a ayyana shi ba, kuma ba shi da alaƙa da iyaka; saboda haka dole a kwatanta ƙimomin daga ɓangarorin biyu, kamar 1 daga dama da −1 daga hagu.

l-m-h2-b0d03-13.title: Wane bayani ne da gaske ake buƙata don lissafin layin tangenti?
l-m-h2-b0d03-13.goal: Ka gano ma'aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata da gaske don nemo lissafin layin tangenti a maki ɗaya na lanƙwasa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h2-b0d03-13.material: Muna son rubuta lissafin layin tangenti a wani maki na lanƙwasar y=f(x). Ka yi tunani game da bayanan da ake buƙata da gaske.
l-m-h2-b0d03-13.s.s1.o.a: Makin da lanƙwasar ta haɗu da axis x
l-m-h2-b0d03-13.s.s1.r.a: Haɗuwar da axis x ba ta da alaƙa kai tsaye da layin tangenti.
l-m-h2-b0d03-13.s.s1.o.b: Haɗin x na makin tangenti da derivative a wannan maki
l-m-h2-b0d03-13.s.s1.r.c: Ana buƙatar ƙima da gangara a makin tangenti.
l-m-h2-b0d03-13.s.s1.r.d: Ba a buƙatar mafi girman ƙima don ƙayyade layin tangenti.
l-m-h2-b0d03-13.s.s1.explain: Layin tangenti yana ƙayyadewa da makin tangenti (haɗin x da ƙimar aikin) da gangara f'(a). Rubuta shi a matsayin y−f(a)=f'(a)(x−a).
l-m-h2-b0d03-13.s.s2.model.0: Ana ƙayyade layi da maki da yake ratsawa da gangararsa. Haɗin makin tangenti da derivative a wannan maki su ne waɗannan bayanai biyun; saboda haka ana buƙatar su.
l-m-h2-b0d03-13.s.s2.model.1: Gangara ita ce derivative a makin tangenti; saboda haka dole a san haɗin x na makin kuma a nemo f'(a) don rubuta lissafin layin tangenti.

l-m-h2-b0d03-23.s.s1.r.a: Darajar a maki guda ba ta nuna alamar aikin a duk zangon ba.

l-m-h2-b0d03-23.s.s1.r.b: Ko cikakkiya ce ba shi da alaƙa da nemo faɗi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-23.s.s1.r.c: Abin da ya shafi shi ne ko jadawalin yana sama ko ƙasa da axis x, ba derivative ba.
l-m-h2-b0d03-23.s.s1.o.d: Ko darajojin f a zangon [0,6] tabbatattu ne ko marasa kyau

l-m-h2-b0d04-02.goal: Yanke shawarar wane ma'auni (bayani) ake buƙata da gaske domin nemo darajar da za ta sa (x²−4)/(x−2) ci gaba a x=2, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h2-b0d04-02.material: f(x)=(x²−4)/(x−2) (x≠2) ba a ayyana shi a x=2 ba. Zaɓi darajar f(2) domin aikin ya ci gaba a x=2.
l-m-h2-b0d04-02.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ake buƙata da gaske domin zaɓar f(2)?
l-m-h2-b0d04-02.s.s1.o.a: Darajar da f(x) ke kusantowa idan x yana kusa da 2
l-m-h2-b0d04-02.s.s1.r.b: Abin da ake buƙata shi ne iyakar furucin gaba ɗaya, ba darajar ma'auni ba.
l-m-h2-b0d04-02.s.s1.r.c: Darajar a maki mai nisa ba ta da alaƙa da ci gaba.
l-m-h2-b0d04-02.s.s1.o.d: x ɗin da mai lissafi x²−4 yake zama 0
l-m-h2-b0d04-02.s.s1.r.d: Abin da ake buƙata shi ne darajar da ake kusantowa, ba maki inda yake sifili ba. [0]
l-m-h2-b0d04-02.s.s1.explain: Domin ci gaba, f(2) dole ya yi daidai da darajar iyaka. Tunda f(x)=x+2 (x≠2), zaɓar f(2)=4 yana sa ya ci gaba.
l-m-h2-b0d04-02.s.s2.model.0: Domin ci gaba f(2) dole ya yi daidai da lim f(x), saboda haka muna buƙatar sanin darajar da yake kusantowa yayin x kusa da 2, wato 4.
l-m-h2-b0d04-02.s.s2.model.1: Soke (x−2) yana bayar da x+2, wanda ke kusantar 4; saboda haka zaɓar f(2) ya zama darajar iyaka 4 yana sa aikin ya ci gaba.

l-m-h2-b0d05-07.s.s1.r.b: Da yiwuwar biyun kaɗai, ba mu san haɗuwar P(A∩B) ba, saboda haka ba a ƙayyade darajar ba.
l-m-h2-b0d05-07.s.s1.r.c: Yiwuwar haɗin saiti kaɗai ba ta nuna rabon A cikin B ba.
l-m-h2-b0d05-07.s.s1.r.d: Jimillar ƙimomin biyun 1 ce, don haka ba su bayar da sabon bayani kuma ba su da alaƙa da B.
l-m-h2-b0d05-07.s.s1.explain: P(A|B)=P(A∩B)/P(B). Muna buƙatar sanin nawa A ya haɗu da B da girman B.
l-m-h2-b0d05-07.s.s2.model.0: P(A|B) ita ce P(A∩B) a raba da P(B), saboda haka waɗannan yiwuwar biyun wajibi ne. Da P(A) da P(B) kaɗai ba mu san haɗuwa ba.

l-m-h2-b0d05-10.goal: Ka gano wane ma'auni (bayani) ne wajibi don nemo ƙimar P(X≥a) ga rarrabuwar al'ada N(m, σ²), sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.material: Idan mabambancin bazuwar X yana bin rarrabuwar al'ada N(m, σ²), muna son nemo P(X≥a) ta amfani da jadawalin al'ada. Ka yi tunani game da ƙimomin da ake buƙata don daidaitawa.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s1.r.a: Ba tare da σ ba, ba za a iya sanin nisan a daga matsakaici a ma'aunin σ ba.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s1.r.b: Ba tare da matsakaici m ba, ba za a iya sanin ko a ya fi matsakaicin girma ko ƙanƙanta ba.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s1.r.c: Ba a amfani da girman samfur wajen daidaitawa; ana buƙatar m da σ.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s1.o.d: Ƙimomi uku m, σ, da a
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s1.explain: Ana daidaitawa da Z=(X-m)/σ; saboda haka ana buƙatar m da σ, da kuma ƙimar tunani a da ake nema.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s2.model.0: Dole a mayar da shi Z=(a-m)/σ; saboda haka ana buƙatar matsakaici m, karkacewar ma'auni σ, da ƙimar tunani a. Idan ɗaya ya ɓace, ba za a iya nemo Z ba.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s2.model.1: Idan m kaɗai ne, ba za a iya rabawa da σ ba; idan σ kaɗai ne, ba za a iya cire matsakaici ba. Saboda haka ana buƙatar dukkan ƙimomi ukun don daidaitawa.

l-m-h2-b0d04-10.s.s2.model.0: Lissafin f'g+fg' ga misalan ukun yana ba da 2x, 3x², da 5x⁴; saboda haka derivative na samfurin ana iya rubuta shi f'g+fg'.

l-m-h2-b0d04-20.s.s1.explain: Tun da V'(10)=300, canjin ≈ 300×0.1=30. Ainihin canjin kuwa 1030.301−1000=30.301 cm³ ne.

l-m-h2-b0d05-19.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tazara ta yi ƙanƙanta sosai, kamar ±0.1. Karkacewar ma'auni na matsakaicin samfur 1 ce.
l-m-h2-b0d05-19.s.s1.explain: Karkacewar ma'auni na matsakaicin samfur ita ce 10÷√100=1. 50±2×1 yana ba da kusan 48~52.
l-m-h2-b0d05-19.s.s2.model.0: Karkacewar ma'auni na matsakaicin samfur 10÷10=1 ce, ma'aunin kuma kusan 2 ne; saboda haka 50±2, wato kusan 48~52.
l-m-h2-b0d05-19.s.s2.model.1: Da samfurin 100, karkacewar ta ragu zuwa σ/√n=1. Ɗaukar ninki 2 a kowane gefe yana ba da kewayo daga 48 zuwa 52, wanda ya dace.

l-m-h2-b0d06-14.s.s1.explain: Adadin yanayin samun hoto 5 shi ne 10C5=252, jimillar kuma 1024 ce. 252/1024≈0.25.
l-m-h2-b0d06-14.s.s2.model.0: Idan aka kimanta 10C5=252 a matsayin 250, 1024 kuma a matsayin 1000, ana samun kusan 1/4, wato kusan 25%.

l-m-h2-b0d02-34.title: Hujjar indukshiya cewa “n²+n bai zama ma’auru ba”: me ya ɓace?
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.goal: Bi matakan hujjar induction cewa n²+n koyaushe mara ma'aurata ne (jerin dalili da sakamako), nemo wurin farko da ya yi kuskure ka gyara shi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.material: Hujjar “n²+n mara ma'aurata ne ga kowace lambar halitta n”. (1) A ɗauka k²+k mara ma'aurata ne idan n=k. (2) (k+1)²+(k+1)=(k²+k)+2(k+1). (3) Mara ma'aurata+ma'aurata=mara ma'aurata, don haka yana aiki ga n=k+1 ma. (4) Yana aiki ga kowace lambar halitta n.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.a: (1) Inda aka ɗauka furucin yana aiki ga n=k
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.r.a: Wannan zato ne da ake yi a matakin induction, yana da kyau.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.b: (2) Inda aka rubuta furucin a matsayin (k²+k)+2(k+1)
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.r.b: Faɗaɗawa yana bayar da furuci iri ɗaya, saboda haka daidai ne.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.c: (3) Inda aka ce mara ma'aurata+ma'aurata=mara ma'aurata
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.d: (4) Inda aka ƙare cewa yana aiki ga duka ba tare da bincika n=1 ba
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.explain: Matakin tushe n=1 ya ɓace. 1²+1=2 ma'aurata ne, a zahiri kuma n²+n koyaushe ma'aurata ne.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s2.model.0: Yana da matakin induction kaɗai, ba a bincika n=1 ba, don haka hujjar ba ta aiki. 1²+1=2 ma'aurata ne, saboda haka furucin ƙarya ne.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s2.model.1: Ba tare da matakin tushe babu wurin farawa, saboda haka ba za a yanke sakamakon (4) ba; n²+n=n(n+1) kuma koyaushe ma'aurata ne, don haka furucin kansa ba daidai ba ne.

l-m-h2-b0d03-05.title: Soke abubuwa idan ma'auni murabba'i ne: Ina kuskuren?
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.goal: Bi matakan maganin nemo lim (x²−1)/(x−1)² (x→1), gano farkon wurin kuskure ka gyara shi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.material: Magani: ① x²−1=(x−1)(x+1) ② Soke da ma'auni (x−1)², a bar x+1 kawai ③ Yayin x→1, x+1→2 ④ Iyaka 2 ce.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi matakin farko da ba daidai ba.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.o.b: ② Soke yana barin x+1 kawai
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.r.c: Wannan lissafin daidai ne, amma matakin baya ya riga ya yi kuskure.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.r.d: Ƙarshe ba daidai ba ne saboda ②. Ba wurin farkon kuskure ba ne.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.explain: (x−1)(x+1)/(x−1)²=(x+1)/(x−1). Tunda (x−1) ya rage a ma'auni, iyaka ba ta wanzu.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s2.model.0: Ana iya soke (x−1)² da (x−1) sau ɗaya kawai, a bar (x+1)/(x−1), don haka ② kuskure ne.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s2.model.1: Saboda (x−1) ya rage a ma'auni, darajar tana ƙaruwa ko raguwa ba iyaka yayin x→1, saboda haka babu iyaka. ② da ya ɗauka an gama sokewa shi ne farkon kuskure.

l-m-h2-b0d03-11.title: Ƙimar da aka samo daga ma'anar derivative: wane layi ne kuskuren farko?
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.goal: Bi matakan warwarewar neman f'(2) ga f(x)=x²+3x ta amfani da ma'ana (jerin dalili da sakamako), nemo wurin farko da kuskure ya faru, sannan ka gyara shi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.material: f(x)=x²+3x. Warwarewa: ① f(2)=10 ② f(2+h)=4+h²+6+3h ③ (f(2+h)−f(2))/h=(h²+3h)/h=h+3 ④ Yayin da h→0, f'(2)=3.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.o.c: ③ Sauƙaƙawa ta hanyar ragewa har a sami h+3
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.r.c: Idan aka yi amfani da sakamakon ②, wannan lissafi daidai ne. Kuskuren farko yana ②.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.r.d: Kammalawar ba daidai ba ce, amma dalilin yana cikin mataki na baya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.explain: (2+h)²=4+4h+h². An bar kalmar tsakiya 4h, saboda haka an sami 3 maimakon f'(2)=7.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s2.model.0: An rubuta (2+h)² a matsayin 4+h², saboda haka an bar 4h. ② ne kuskuren farko; idan aka yi daidai, (7h+h²)/h→7.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s2.model.1: Ba a bi ka'idar ninkawa (2+h)²=4+4h+h² ba; saboda haka kuskuren ya faru a ② kuma dole a gyara zuwa f'(2)=7.

l-m-h2-b0d03-20.goal: Bi matakan warwarewar ƙaruwa da raguwa na f(x)=x³−3x² (ko jerin dalilai da sakamako), nemo wurin farko da kuskure ya faru sannan ka gyara shi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.material: f(x)=x³−3x². Warwarewa: ① f'(x)=3x²−6x ② Daga f'(x)=0, x=0 ko x=2 ③ Ga x<0, f'(x)=3x(x−2)<0 ④ Saboda haka akwai mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta gida idan x=0.
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s1.r.b: Waɗannan mafita ne na 3x(x−2)=0; saboda haka daidai ne.

l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s1.r.d: Kammalawar da ba daidai ba ta samo asali ne daga ③. Ba shi ne kuskuren farko ba.
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s1.explain: Idan x<0, to 3x<0 kuma x−2<0; saboda haka f'(x)>0. A hagu na x=0 aikin yana ƙaruwa sannan ya ragu; saboda haka akwai mafi girman ƙima ta gida.
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s2.model.0: Ga x<0, 3x da x−2 duk marasa kyau ne; saboda haka samfurinsu f'(x) mai kyau ne, wanda ke nuna ③ ne kuskuren farko.

l-m-h2-b0d03-26.material: Maganin integral takamaimai na |x| daga −1 zuwa 1: ① |x|=−x idan x<0, kuma x idan x≥0 ② Saboda haka maye gurbin |x| da x a haɗa integral ɗin gaba ɗaya ③ Integral takamaimai na x shi ne [x²/2]=0 ④ Saboda haka darajar 0 ce.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.o.b: ② Maye gurbin |x| da x a haɗa integral ɗin gaba ɗaya
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.o.c: ③ Integral takamaimai na x shi ne 0
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.r.c: Lissafin nan kansa daidai ne. Matsalar furucin da aka kafa ba daidai ba ne.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.r.d: Ƙarshen kuskure ya samo asali daga ②.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.explain: Ga x<0, |x|=−x. (integral takamaimai na −x daga −1 zuwa 0)+(integral takamaimai na x daga 0 zuwa 1)=1/2+1/2=1.

l-m-h2-b0d04-05.title: Iyakacin mai ƙididdigewa 0 ne; har yanzu za mu iya amfani da ƙa'idar rabon iyakoki?
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.goal: Bi matakan warwarewar lim (x²−1)/(x−1) yayin da x→1 (ko jerin dalilai da sakamako), nemo wurin farko da kuskure ya faru sannan ka gyara shi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.material: Warwarewa: ① Yayin da x→1, iyakar x²−1 ita ce 0 ② Iyakacin x−1 ma 0 ce ③ Iyakacin rabo shi ne rabon iyakoki, saboda haka 0÷0=1 ④ Saboda haka ƙimar iyakar ita ce 1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s1.o.a: ① Iyakacin mai ƙidaya ita ce 0
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s1.r.a: Sanya x=1 yana ba da 0; saboda haka daidai ne.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s1.o.b: ② Iyakacin mai ƙididdigewa ita ce 0
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s1.r.d: Kammalawar da ba daidai ba ta samo asali ne daga ③.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s1.explain: Ana iya amfani da ƙa'idar rabon iyakoki ne kawai idan iyakar mai ƙididdigewa ba 0 ba ce. Rage abubuwan da suka yi daidai yana ba da x+1; saboda haka ƙimar iyaka daidai ita ce 2.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s2.model.0: Idan iyakar mai ƙididdigewa 0 ce, ba za a iya amfani da ƙa'idar rabon ba; 0÷0 ba shi da ƙima tabbatacciya, saboda haka ③ ba daidai ba ne.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s2.model.1: Rage (x−1) yana ba da x+1; saboda haka iyakar ita ce 2. Wannan yana nuna cewa ③, wanda ya ce 0÷0=1, shi ne kuskuren farko.

l-m-h2-b0d04-14.title: Duba warwarewar neman ƙimomin da ba a sani ba daga sharadin mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta gida
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.goal: Bi matakan warwarewar da ke amfani da sharadin mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta gida ga f(x)=x³+ax²+bx (ko jerin dalilai da sakamako), nemo wurin farko da kuskure ya faru sannan ka gyara shi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.material: f(x)=x³+ax²+bx yana da mafi ƙarancin ƙima ta gida −1 idan x=1. Warwarewa: ① f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b ② Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida −1 ce; saboda haka f'(1)=−1 ③ 3+2a+b=−1 ④ Warware tare da ɗayan sharadin domin nemo a da b.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s1.o.b: ② Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida −1 ce; saboda haka f'(1)=−1
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s1.r.c: Wannan furuci ya biyo bayan ②; saboda haka ② ne kuskuren farko.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s1.o.d: ④ Warware tare da ɗayan sharadin
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s1.r.d: Amfani da f(1)=−1 daidai ne. Kuskuren farko yana ②.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s1.explain: A inda akwai matsananciyar ƙima, f'(1)=0; mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida −1 kuma yana nufin f(1)=−1. Ta amfani da waɗannan sharuɗɗan biyu, a=−1 da b=−1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s2.model.0: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar gida −1 yana nufin f(1)=−1, ba f'(1)=−1 ba; saboda haka ② ba daidai ba ne kuma dole a yi amfani da f'(1)=0.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s2.model.1: Idan akwai matsananciyar ƙima idan x=1, tangenti a kwance yake kuma f'(1)=0; saboda haka ②, wanda ya yi amfani da −1 a matsayin ƙimar derivative, shi ne kuskuren farko.

l-m-h2-b0d04-15.goal: Bi matakan warwarewar layukan tangenti na y=x³−3x masu gangara 9 (ko jerin dalilai da sakamako), nemo wurin farko da kuskure ya faru sannan ka gyara shi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.material: Nemo maki tangenti a kan lanƙwasar y=x³−3x inda tangenti ke da gangara 9: ① y'=3x²−3 ② Daga 3x²−3=9, x²=4 ③ Saboda haka x=2 ④ Makin tangenti shi ne (2, 2).
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s1.r.b: Sauƙaƙa 3x²−3=9 yana ba da x²=4; saboda haka wannan daidai ne.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s1.r.d: (2,2) maki ne na tangenti; amma nemo shi kaɗai ya faru ne saboda kuskuren ③.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s1.explain: Idan x²=4, to x=2 ko x=−2. Akwai maki tangenti biyu, (2, 2) da (−2, −2), kuma gangarar kowannensu 9 ce.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s2.model.0: An gyara ③ saboda x²=4 yana da mafita biyu, 2 da −2; an manta da −2. Akwai wuraren taɓa lanƙwasa guda biyu masu gangara 9.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s2.model.1: Tun da y' ya ƙunshi murabba’in x kuma yana da ƙima iri ɗaya ga x da −x, x=−2 ma mafita ce, kuma wurin taɓa lanƙwasa (−2, −2) ma yana nan.

l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s1.explain: G(1) constant ne, don haka derivative ɗinsa 0 ne. g'(x)=G'(x)=x²+2x, kuma g'(2)=8.

l-m-h2-b0d02-04.title: Sake Rubuta 16^(3/4) da Tushen da Adadi
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.goal: Rubuta 16^(3/4) ta amfani da tushen murabba’i
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.material: Ana son rubuta 16^(3/4), wanda yake da kason exponent, ta amfani da alamar tushen, sannan a nemo ƙimarsa.
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s1.prompt: Wane furuci ne ya yi daidai da 16^(3/4)?
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s1.r.a: Wannan 16^(4/3) ne; an musanya wuri tsakanin denominator da numerator.
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s1.r.b: Exponent 3/4 ba adadin ninkawa ba ne; yana nuna ƙarfin da za a ɗaga zuwa gare shi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s1.r.c: Denominator 4 ba adadin rabawa ba ne; yana nuna darajar tushen.
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s2.model.0: Denominator 4 yana nuna tushen na 4 (4th root), numerator 3 kuma yana nuna ɗagawa zuwa ƙarfin 3. Saboda haka 16^(3/4)=(⁴√16)³=2³=8.
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s2.model.1: Da yake 16^(1/4)=2 kuma 16^(3/4)=(16^(1/4))³, ana iya sake rubuta shi a matsayin 8, wato ƙarfin uku na 2.

l-m-h2-b0d02-19.title: Bayyana jadawalin cos a matsayin matsawar jadawalin sin
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.goal: Mayar da bayanin y=cosx a matsayin matsawar y=sinx zuwa wata siga (furuci, tebur, hoto ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin ma'anarsu iri ɗaya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.material: Muna son bayyana jadawalin y=cos x a matsayin matsawar jadawalin y=sin x.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.prompt: Wane jadawali ne daidai da y=cos x?
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.o.a: y=sin x da aka matsar hagu da π/2
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.o.b: y=sin x da aka matsar sama da π/2
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.r.b: Matsar sama kawai yana ƙara π/2 ga ƙimar y, wanda ya bambanta da cos x.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.o.c: y=sin x da aka matsar dama da π
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.r.c: sin(x−π)=−sin x ne, saboda haka ba cos x ba.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.o.d: y=sin x da aka matsar dama da π/2
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.r.d: sin(x−π/2)=−cos x ne, saboda haka an juya shi ƙasa.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.explain: cos x=sin(x+π/2). Matsar da jadawalin sin hagu da π/2 yana bayar da jadawalin cos.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s2.model.0: Tunda cos x=sin(x+π/2), y=sin x ne inda aka maye gurbin x da x+π/2, wato an matsar da jadawali hagu da π/2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s2.model.1: sin x yana kai 1 a x=π/2, cos x kuma a x=0, saboda haka matsar da jadawalin sin hagu da π/2 yana sa su rufe juna. [1]

l-m-h2-b0d03-06.s.s2.model.0: Yayin da x ke kusantar 2, f(x) yana kusantar f(2), ma'ana daidai da daidaiton cewa iyaka da darajar aikin sun yi daidai.

l-m-h2-b0d03-16.title: Canjin alamar derivative a matsayin siffar zane
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.goal: Mayar da furucin ‘alamar f' tana canzawa daga + zuwa − idan x=2’ zuwa wani salo (furuci, jadawali, zane, ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa suke nufin abu ɗaya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.material: A hagu na x=2, f'(x)>0; a dama kuma f'(x)<0, kuma f tana ci gaba ba tare da tsallakewa ba idan x=2. Sake bayyana wannan ta amfani da siffar zanen f.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi furucin da yake nufin abu ɗaya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.o.a: Idan x=2, yana sauka sannan ya tashi, ya kai ƙasan zane
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.r.a: Canji daga + zuwa − yana nufin yana ƙaruwa sannan ya ragu; saboda haka kololuwa ce (mafi girman ƙimar gida).
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.o.b: Idan x=2, yana ci gaba da tashi
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.r.b: A dama, f'<0 ne; saboda haka yana sauka.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.o.c: Idan x=2, yana tashi sannan ya sauka, ya kai kololuwa
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.r.d: Tun da f tana ci gaba, zanen bai karye ba.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.explain: Idan f'>0, f tana ƙaruwa; idan f'<0, tana raguwa. Idan x=2, inda take canzawa daga ƙaruwa zuwa raguwa, akwai mafi girman ƙima ta gida.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s2.model.0: A hagu f'>0 ne, saboda haka zane yana hawa; a dama f'<0, yana sauka. Saboda haka siffar tana da mafi girman ƙima ta gida idan x=2.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s2.model.1: Tun da tana canzawa daga ƙaruwa zuwa raguwa, akwai kololuwa idan x=2; wannan yana nufin alamar derivative ta canza daga + zuwa −.

l-m-h2-b0d03-27.material: Saurin maki v(t)=2t (m/s) ne. Duba tazarar ∫2t dt da aka yi daga daƙiƙa 0 zuwa 4 a matsayin siffar ƙarƙashin jadawali, sannan ka mayar da ita ƙa'idar faɗi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi furucin da ke bayar da daraja iri ɗaya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s1.r.a: Faɗin murabba'i ne. A ƙarƙashin jadawalin alwatika ce, saboda haka rabinsa ne.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s1.r.b: Ka ɗauki tsayi 2. A t=4, v=8 ne.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s1.r.c: Ka ɗauki tushe 8. Tsawon zangon 4 ne.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s1.explain: Ƙarƙashin y=2t alwatika ce mai tushe 4 da tsayi v(4)=8. Faɗinta 16 ne, daidai da darajar integral takamaimai.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s2.model.0: Tsakanin jadawalin v=2t da axis t akwai alwatika mai kusurwar dama, tushe 4 tsayi 8, don haka faɗinsa (1/2)×4×8=16 daidai da integral takamaimai.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s2.model.1: Sauri 8 ne a t=4, yana ƙaruwa daidai daga 0 zuwa 4, saboda haka siffar alwatika ce, integral takamaimai kuma (1/2)×4×8 ne.

l-m-h2-b0d03-28.title: Bayyana ma'anar integral marar takamaimai ta amfani da differentiation
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.goal: Mayar da integral marar takamaimai ∫(3x²+2x)dx zuwa wata siga (furuci, tebur, zane ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin ma'anarsu iri ɗaya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.material: ∫(3x²+2x)dx=x³+x²+C. Ta amfani da differentiation, bayyana ma'anar integral marar takamaimai ta wata hanya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.o.a: Dukkan ayyukan da idan aka yi musu derivative suke bayar da 3x²+2x
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.r.b: An juya alkibla. Aikin ne kafin a yi derivative, ba sakamakon differentiation ba.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.o.c: Faɗin da ke ƙarƙashin jadawalin 3x²+2x guda ɗaya
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.r.c: Ba darajar faɗi guda ba ce, tarin ayyuka ne.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.r.d: Ko C ya bambanta, differentiation yana bayar da sakamako iri ɗaya, saboda haka x³+x²+5 ma yana ciki.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.explain: Ko wane ne C, differentiation na x³+x²+C yana bayar da 3x²+2x. Integral marar takamaimai yana nufin dukkan irin waɗannan ayyuka.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s2.model.0: Differentiation na x³+x²+C yana soke C, ya bayar da 3x²+2x; saboda haka integral marar takamaimai dukkan ayyukan da derivative ɗinsu 3x²+2x ne.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s2.model.1: Ko da constant C ya bambanta, sakamakon derivative iri ɗaya ne, don haka ba aiki ɗaya kaɗai ba ne, duk ayyukan da derivative ɗinsu 3x²+2x ne.

l-m-h2-b0d04-06.title: Sake rubuta |x−3|/(x−3) bisa tazarar x
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.goal: Sake rubuta furucin |x−3|/(x−3) a wani salo (furuci, jadawali, zane, ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma'anar take iri ɗaya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.material: Muna son rubuta f(x)=|x−3|/(x−3) (x≠3) bisa tazarar x ba tare da cikakken ƙima ba. Wannan yana taimakawa wajen zana jadawali ko bincika iyakoki daga hagu da dama.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi furucin da yake nuna aiki iri ɗaya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s1.r.a: An juya alamomin. Sanya x=4 yana ba da 1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s1.r.c: Idan x=2, |−1|/(−1)=−1; saboda haka bai dace ba.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s1.r.d: Mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa suna da girma iri ɗaya; saboda haka ƙimar ita ce ±1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s1.explain: Idan x>3, |x−3|=x−3, saboda haka rabon 1 ne. Idan x<3, |x−3|=−(x−3), saboda haka rabon −1 ne.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s2.model.0: Idan x>3, |x−3|=x−3, saboda haka rabon 1 ne; idan x<3, |x−3|=−(x−3), saboda haka rabon −1 ne.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s2.model.1: Sanya x=4 yana ba da 1/1=1, sanya x=2 kuma yana ba da 1/(−1)=−1; saboda haka bisa tazarar x ƙimomin su ne 1 da −1.

l-m-h2-b0d04-16.title: Bayyana derivative f'(3) ta wata hanya
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.goal: Sake bayyana derivative f'(3) ta wata hanya (tsari, tebur, hoto, ko kalmomi), ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anar take ɗaya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.material: f'(3) shi ne iyakar (f(3+h)−f(3))/h yayin da h→0. Ka sa x=3+h, sannan ka yi amfani da x don sake rubuta shi a matsayin furuci mai ma’ana iri ɗaya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.s.s1.r.a: Idan f yana ci gaba, sai ya zama 0, don haka ba ƙimar canji ba ce.
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.s.s1.r.b: An bar ɓangaren da ke cire f(3) da kuma wanda ke raba da x−3.
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.s.s1.r.c: Matsakaicin ƙimar canji ne daga x=0 zuwa 3.
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.s.s1.explain: Idan x=3+h, to h=x−3, kuma h→0 yana nufin x→3. Saboda haka iyakar (f(x)−f(3))/(x−3) ita ce f'(3).
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.s.s2.model.0: Saita x=3+h yana sa h ya zama x−3, kuma h→0 ya zama x→3; saboda haka waɗannan furuci biyu iyaka ɗaya ce da sunaye daban.
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.s.s2.model.1: Mai lamba shi ne f(3+h)−f(3)=f(x)−f(3), mai ƙasa kuma h=x−3, don haka furucin da aka sake rubutawa yana da ƙima iri ɗaya da na asali.

l-m-h2-b0d04-17.goal: Sake bayyana jimlar “gangaren layin taɓawa a wurin (2, 5) shi ne 3” ta wata hanya (tsari, tebur, hoto, ko kalmomi), ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anar take ɗaya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.material: Gangaren layin taɓa lanƙwasa y=f(x) a wurin (2, 5) shi ne 3. Muna son sake bayyana wannan da furuci mai amfani da f da f'.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s1.r.b: An musanya haɗin x da y. Ma’anar wurin ita ce x=2, y=5.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s1.r.c: An musanya ƙimar aikin da gangaren.

l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s1.explain: Tun da lanƙwasar ta ratsa (2, 5), f(2)=5, kuma gangaren taɓawa a wurin ita ce f'(2)=3.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s2.model.0: Tun da wurin (2, 5) yana kan lanƙwasar, f(2)=5; gangaren taɓawa ita ce ƙimar derivative, don haka f'(2)=3.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s2.model.1: Ƙimar aikin a haɗin x=2 ita ce 5, don haka f(2)=5; gangaren a wurin kuma ita ce 3, don haka muna rubuta f'(2)=3.

l-m-h2-b0d06-27.goal: Mayar da “aƙalla ɗaya daga A ko B ya faru” zuwa wata siga (furuci, tebur, hoto ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin ma'anarta iri ɗaya.

l-m-h2-b0d01-20.material: Zanen y=sin(2x−π/3) an samu shi ne ta hanyar matsar da zanen y=sin2x a kan axis x. Kwatanta da'awoyi game da nisa da alkiblar matsawar.

l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.r.a: − ba ya nufin hagu kai tsaye; kuma dole a fitar da 2 a matsayin gama-gari.
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.o.b: Zuwa hagu da π/6: domin alamar tana canzawa idan aka fitar da gama-gari
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.r.b: x−π/6 yana nufin matsawa zuwa dama. Matsawa zuwa hagu ita ce x+π/6.
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.o.c: Zuwa dama da π/3: domin lissafin yana da −π/3
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.r.c: Fitar da ƙididdigar 2 ta x yana ba da 2(x−π/6); saboda haka matsawar π/6 ce.
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.o.d: Zuwa dama da π/6: ta hanyar fitar da 2 a matsayin gama-gari a samu 2(x−π/6)
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.explain: sin(2x−π/3)=sin2(x−π/6); saboda haka zanen y=sin2x ne da aka matsar da π/6 zuwa dama.
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s2.model.0: 2x−π/3=2(x−π/6); saboda haka an maye gurbin x a y=sin2x da x−π/6, wato an matsar da shi π/6 zuwa dama.
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s2.model.1: Kada a duba π/3 shi kaɗai ba tare da fitar da ƙididdigar 2 ta x ba. Dole a sake rubuta shi 2(x−π/6), sannan a gane cewa matsawar π/6 ce zuwa dama.

l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.r.b: Yana da muhimmanci ko an fara ɗaukar murabba'i ko an fara haɗawa.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.o.c: B: Gefen hagu koyaushe ya fi na dama girma
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.r.c: Idan n=2, 5<9 ne, saboda haka gefen hagu a zahiri ya fi ƙanƙanta.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.explain: Idan n=2, 1²+2²=5, (1+2)²=9, don haka sun bambanta. Misalin karyatawa guda ya isa karya A.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s2.model.0: Idan n=2, Σk²=1²+2²=5, (Σk)²=(1+2)²=9, sun bambanta, saboda haka A kuskure ne, B daidai.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s2.model.1: Jimillar murabba'ai da murabba'in jimilla ba su daidaita ba, domin (1+2)² yana ƙirƙirar kalmar haɗin kai 2·1·2. n=2 hujja ce.

l-m-h2-b0d05-33.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi ko da’awoyi biyu game da nemo 8P3, zaɓi wadda ta fi dacewa, ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.material: Dalibai biyu sun lissafa hanyoyin ba mutane 3 daga cikin 8 lambobin zinariya, azurfa da tagulla bisa jeri. Dalibi A: 8×7×6=336. Dalibi B: fara zaɓar mutane 3 (8C3=56), sannan a yanke jeri na lambobin yabo, 56×6=336. Ka yi tunanin dalilin da ya sa ƙimomin suka yi daidai.
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.prompt: Wane ne dalilin da ya sa ƙimomin biyu suka yi daidai?

l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.r.b: 8P3 ba sau 3 na 8C3 ba ne, sai sau 3!=6.
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.r.c: An juya alkiblar. 8P3 shi ne 8C3 da aka ninka da 6.
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.o.d: Ƙimomin biyun sun yi daidai ne bisa sa'a

l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.explain: Ninka 8C3, zaɓar mutane 3, da 3!=6, jerin mutanen ukun, yana bayar da 8P3. 56×6=336 kuma nPr=nCr×r!. [3]
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s2.model.0: Zaɓar mutane 3 da 8C3 sannan ninkawa da 3!=6, hanyoyin jera ukun, yana ƙidaya jeri ma, saboda haka daidai yake da 8P3. [3]

l-m-h2-b0d02-09.material: Matakin hayaniya shi ne L=10log(I/I₀) dB. Ana son rage hayaniyar 80 dB ta yanzu zuwa 60 dB ko ƙasa da haka. Ana ƙayyade aikin hana sauti da rabon da ƙarfin sauti I zai ragu zuwa (1 cikin nawa), kuma kuɗin aikin bai kamata ya wuce 50 ba.

l-m-h2-b0d02-09.s.s1.r.a: 80−10=70 dB ne, wanda bai kai 60 dB ko ƙasa ba.
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.s.s1.r.b: 80−10log50≈63 dB ne, wanda bai kai 60 dB ko ƙasa ba.
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.s.s1.r.d: Yana rage hayaniyar zuwa 50 dB, amma kuɗin 90 ya wuce iyakar 50.
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.s.s1.explain: Rage ƙarfin zuwa 1/100 yana rage matakin da 10log100=20 dB, zuwa 60 dB; kuɗin 40 kuma yana cikin iyakar.
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.s.s2.model.0: Rage ƙarfin zuwa 1/100 yana rage matakin da 20 dB zuwa 60 dB, kuma kuɗin 40 bai wuce 50 ba, don haka an cika sharuɗɗan biyu.
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.s.s2.model.1: 1/10 da 1/50 ba su dace ba domin hayaniyar tana nan sama da 60 dB; 1/1000 kuma bai dace ba domin kuɗin ya wuce 50. Saboda haka 1/100 ya rage.

l-m-h2-b0d03-18.title: Shinge da ke amfani da bango: yaya za a zaɓi faɗi?
l-m-h2-b0d03-18.goal: Ga faɗin shingen murabba'i mai amfani da bango a gefe ɗaya, yi la'akari da sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa, zaɓi mafi kyawun daidaitawa, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-h2-b0d03-18.material: Yi amfani da bangon a matsayin gefe ɗaya, sannan a yi amfani da duk 60m na igiyar shinge ga sauran gefuna uku domin yin fili mai siffar murabba'i. Gefen da yake layi ɗaya da bango dole bai wuce 24m ba, kuma mafi girman fili ya fi kyau. Faɗin x shi ne gefen da ya yi tsaye da bango.
l-m-h2-b0d03-18.s.s1.prompt: Wane x ne yake ba da mafi girman fili tare da cika sharuɗɗan?
l-m-h2-b0d03-18.s.s1.r.a: Gefen da ke kan bango yana da 40m, wanda ya fi 24m girma.
l-m-h2-b0d03-18.s.s1.r.b: Filin ya fi girma, amma gefen bangon yana da 30m, wanda ya fi 24m girma.
l-m-h2-b0d03-18.s.s1.r.d: Yana cika sharuɗɗan, amma filin 400 ne, wanda ya fi ƙarancin filin idan x=18.
l-m-h2-b0d03-18.s.s1.explain: A=x(60−2x) yana da mafi girman ƙima idan x=15, amma 60−2x≤24 yana nufin x≥18. A wannan kewayon, A yana raguwa; saboda haka x=18 ne mafi dacewa.
l-m-h2-b0d03-18.s.s2.model.0: x=15 yana ba da mafi girman fili, amma gefen bangon, 30m, ya fi 24m girma; saboda haka ba a yarda da shi ba. Ga x≥18, filin yana raguwa; saboda haka x=18 ne mafi dacewa.
l-m-h2-b0d03-18.s.s2.model.1: Daga sharadin gefen bango 60−2x≤24 ana samun x≥18. A wannan kewayon filin yana raguwa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa; saboda haka filin ya fi girma idan x=18, wato 432.

l-m-h2-b0d04-18.s.s1.explain: V=x²(30−2x) ya fi girma a x=10, amma sharaɗin tsawo 30−2x≤8 yana nufin x≥11. Ga x≥10, V yana raguwa, don haka x=11 shi ne mafi dacewa.

l-m-h2-b0d04-29.s.s1.explain: Adadin da aka zuba T² L ne. T=4 yana bayar da 16 L, bai isa ba; 4.5 kuma yana bayar da 20.25 L, ya cika sharuɗɗan. Ya fi 5 da 6 sauri.
